percentage.description:
The percentage of training data. The default is 80, meaning we split
the dataset chronologically into 20% validation and 80% training.

splitOn.description:
If provided, split the dataset by timestamp. This will take precedence
over {@link percentage}.

doNotReverse.description:
The default approach to splitting the dataset is chronogically validation
which is followed by training dataset, i.e., the first section of the
dataset will be used for validating the {@link MlModel} and the latter
portion of the dataset will be used to train the {@link MlModel}.
If the user wants to take the more common approach of training dataset
followed by validation dataset, set this field to `true`.
In practice, however, it has been observed that {@link MlModel}s work
better in production when trained on the latest data available. This is
why the default is set to `false`.

trainStart.description:
If this field and the other three fields, i.e., {@link trainEnd}, {@link valStart},
and {@link valEnd} are provided, then the dataset will be split according
to these dates. These dates will take precedence over {@link percentage} splitting
of the data or timestamp based splitting defined by {@link splitOn}.

trainEnd.description:
If this field and the other three fields, i.e., {@link trainStart}, {@link valStart},
and {@link valEnd} are provided, then the dataset will be split according
to these dates. These dates will take precedence over {@link percentage} splitting
of the data or timestamp based splitting defined by {@link splitOn}.

valStart.description:
If this field and the other three fields, i.e., {@link trainStart}, {@link trainEnd},
and {@link valEnd} are provided, then the dataset will be split according
to these dates. These dates will take precedence over {@link percentage} splitting
of the data or timestamp based splitting defined by {@link splitOn}.

valEnd.description:
If this field and the other three fields, i.e., {@link trainStart}, {@link trainEnd},
and {@link valStart} are provided, then the dataset will be split according
to these dates. These dates will take precedence over {@link percentage} splitting
of the data or timestamp based splitting defined by {@link splitOn}.

title:
Once all the {@link Feature.Set}s have been created and preprocessed by
{@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationHelper#prepareMlDatasets}, the final step will be to split the
datasets into training and validation datasets. The default behavior is to split the dataset into
20/80 validation/train datasets, i.e., the first 20% of the data will be used for {@link MlModel}
validation and the latest 80% will be used for training the {@link MlModel}.

This default behavior can be changed to do the following:
- Change 20/80 to 30/70 or some other percentage split by changing the {@link #percentage} field values.
- Instead of percentage split, choose to split on a certain date by setting the {@link #splitOn} field to a datetime.
- Reverse 20/80 to 80/20, i.e. instead of validation/train change it to train/validation by changing the {@link doNotReverse} field values.
- Gain full control by explicitly providing {@link #trainStart}, {@link #trainEnd}, {@link #valStart}, and {@link #valEnd}. If these 4 are provided, it will take precedence over any other method of splitting the dataset.
name: ReliabilityMlTrainValSplitSpec
